title: Doesn't work as intended!
body:
Was forced to switch to ToDo from Wunderlist (which always worked like a charm). The transition wasn't smooth at all. App constantly shows "Something wrong" errors, which are usually gone on the second try. I've imported all the lists from Wunderlist, but can't share them with my wife - she always get an error "List not found. Contact owner". It doesn't matter if I try to share existing (imported from Wunderlist) or completely new list - first it will show dreaded "Something wrong" error when I try to generate the share link, and after the second try the generated link will show "List not found" error on my wife phone. 
All that is not something I'd expect from the company like Microsoft... 😞
